name: suite-tool-followups
body:
The code that implements the three hygiene fixes on the suite's install+authoring surface: the shared suite lib's `runCli` (fix B — reuse the exported `NO_DB_ERROR` constant rather than a duplicated literal), the plan-update path — the `--no-fqn` sentinel on the CLI wrapper `apg.plan_cmd.plan_update` and its forwarding from the `apg_plan_add` tool (fix A) — and the `OPENCODE_PACKAGE_JSON` installer const in `src/main.rs` (fix C — pin `@opencode-ai/plugin` to the same version as `opencode-suite/package.json`). Nothing else changes.

Anchoring: a durable `implemented-by` anchor must be a checkout-independent FQN (a Module, Struct or Function). An absolute File path embeds the checkout/worktree directory, so the same file resolves to a different FQN in a worktree than on `main` and the main rebuild reports spec drift; a File path must never be a durable anchor (it is fine as a transient plan task target). Consequently this component anchors only the code that genuinely changes and is checkout-independent. The other two fixes — the `apg_plan_add` tool's forwarding (fix A's tool half) and the installer plugin-pin const in `src/main.rs` (fix C) — are delivered as embedded/scaffolded content with no checkout-independent code FQN: a suite `.ts` tool body is an anonymous callback with no Function node, and the pin is a module-level const whose delivering function `apg.install_suite` is not itself changed. They are carried by their plan tasks and judged by review, not by an `implemented-by` anchor.
